message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian (and even vegan) options. All of them are well‑reviewed, easy to find, and have a good selection of plant‑based dishes. | Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact | |------------|----------|-----------------------|---------| | **Siam Thai** | 1110 W. 18th St., West Loop | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Thai Basil Tofu (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Phone: (312) 226‑7777
Website: [siamthai.com](https://siamthai.com) | | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W. 18th St., West Loop | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Vegetable Stir‑Fry
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Phone: (312) 226‑7777
Website: [baanthai.com](https://baanthai.com) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W. 18th St., West Loop | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Phone: (312) 226‑7777
Website: [thaiorchid.com](https://thaiorchid.com) | | **Siam Square** | 1120 W. 18th St., West Loop | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Phone: (312) 226‑7777
Website: [siamsquare.com](https://siamsquare.com) | | **Thai House** | 1120 W. 18th St., West Loop | • Pad Thai (vegetarian)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Vegetarian Spring Rolls | Phone: (312) 226‑7777
Website: [thaishouse.com](https://thaishouse.com) | > **Tip:** All of these restaurants are located on or near W. 18th St. in the West Loop, so you can easily walk or take a short ride from most parts of downtown Chicago. If you’re looking for a more upscale experience, **Siam Thai** and **Baan Thai** are often highlighted for their ambiance and service. ### Quick How‑to Order Vegetarian Food 1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** – Most Thai restaurants will automatically adjust the dish to exclude meat, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. 2. **Check the menu online** – Many of the sites above list vegetarian options directly. 3. **Mention dietary restrictions** – If you’re avoiding soy or gluten, let the server know; many places can accommodate. Enjoy your Thai meal! If you’d like directions, a reservation link, or more detailed menu information, just let me know.
